title: Autoresearch-Bio Split Manifest
description: Declares the four mandatory split roles for an autoresearch loop, per core_protocol.md §3.5. Pairwise sample-ID intersections between roles must be empty. Validated as part of the leakage pre-flight check before the loop launches.

dataset.description: Human-readable dataset identifier, e.g. 'MLOmics GS-BRCA Top 3-omic'.

dataset_commit_or_version.description: Upstream dataset commit hash, release tag, or version string.

creation_commit.description: Repo commit at which this manifest was generated.

creation_seed.description: Random seed used to construct the splits, when applicable. Use -1 if splits are deterministic from upstream.

legacy_test.description: Optional. Historical reference split from earlier exploratory work. Cited for context only; never used for current selection, status, or claims.

passed.description: Must be true for the manifest to be valid.

checked_pairs.description: List of role-name pairs whose sample-ID intersections were verified empty.

code_citation.description: File path and line range of the code that performs the disjointness check.

sample_ids.description: Canonical sample identifiers in this role. Must be unique within the role.

label_distribution.description: Optional. Map from class label to count, when labels exist.

permitted_uses.description: Allowed use sites for this split role. The leakage pre-flight audit cross-checks the codebase against this list.

source_file.description: Optional. Path to the upstream file or fold-definition artifact that produced this split.
